60:12.text: O Prophet! When believing women come to you to give you the Bai‘ah

, that they will not associate anything in worship with Allâh, that they will not steal, that they will not commit illegal sexual intercourse, that they will not kill their children, that they will not utter slander, intentionally forging falsehood
(i.e. by making illegal children belonging to their husbands)
, and that they will not disobey you in Ma‘rûf
(Islâmic Monotheism and all that which Islâm ordains)
, and ask Allâh to forgive them. Verily, Allâh is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

60:13.text: O you who believe! Take not as friends the people who incurred the Wrath of Allâh
the Hereafter, just as the disbelievers have despaired of those
(that they will not be resurrected on the Day of Resurrection)

61:1.text: Whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is on the earth glorifies Allâh. And He is the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.

61:2.text: O you who believe! Why do you say that which you do not do?

61:3.text: Most hateful it is with Allâh that you say that which you do not do.

61:4.text: Verily, Allâh loves those who fight in His Cause in rows
as if they were a solid structure.

61:5.text: said to his people: "O my people! Why do you annoy me while you know certainly that I am the Messenger of Allâh to you? So when they turned away
. And Allâh guides not the people who are Fâsiqûn
